subject.title: [Bug]: Write/exec tool parameters silently dropped after long conversations (content/command missing)

question: After the compact Tool Search subset is fixed, what current-main live proof is sufficient to close this broad long-session tool-argument loss tracker?
rationale: The current source proves one remaining subset, but the issue also includes provider streaming, large-argument, CJK, and long-session reports that may not be covered by the open Tool Search PR.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker Until Live Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers have a current-main long-session proof that write, exec, and wrapped Tool Search calls preserve arguments across the reported failure modes.

options.title: Split Remaining Scope
options.body: Close only a narrower subset after the Tool Search fix lands and open a separate maintainer-authored tracker for provider streaming or large-argument loss.

options.title: Close After Tool Search Fix
options.body: Treat the open Tool Search fix as sufficient and close the broad issue after merge, accepting the risk that original provider/large-payload symptoms may recur separately.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker Until Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers have a current-main long-session proof that write, exec, and wrapped Tool Search calls preserve arguments across the reported failure modes.

likelyOwner.reason: Tool Search and code-mode history make this the best available owner for deciding whether the wrapper fix is enough or whether the broad tracker needs more proof.
